decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 30 March 2005, the erection of an outbuilding measuring 4.27 metres deep, 5.92 metres wide and 4.0 metres high to the top of the ridged roof was lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:

The development falls within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class E of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 because it is for purposes incidental to the enjoyment of the house and falls below the size limits set by the Order

Condition : 2 - Informative:

The detached outbuilding hereby found to be lawful shall only be used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the single-family dwellinghouse known as 40 Legrace Avenue and for no other purpose (i.e. it shall not be used as a bedroom, living room, office or other business use or as a separate dwelling and should not include toilet, bathroom or kitchen facilities).
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the erection of a detached single storey outbuilding to rear of house.
